name: v1-cp3-glm-ocr-data-uri-fix
title: CP3-H 修正 GLM OCR data URI 请求格式
description: 修正 Python OCR 适配器传给 GLM layout_parsing 的 file 参数格式，从裸 base64 改为带 MIME 的 data URI，并补测试与验收证据。
creator: tianqingyuluo
notes: Added during CP3 live demo after GLM OCR returned 400 for valid PDF/JPEG uploads. Root cause confirmed: Worker sends raw base64 in the `file` field; GLM layout_parsing accepts public URLs or data URIs such as `data:image/jpeg;base64,...` and `data:application/pdf;base64,...`.

meta.unlockCriteria: CP3 Worker can download Java-stored materials and GLM OCR credentials are configured.
meta.gatePolicy: Fix OCR request encoding and tests only; do not change review reasoning, RBAC, storage, or frontend preview scope in this task.
